observations.finding: Signer JAR, both SO files, ms_16777218.bin and the 69-entry devices.json are byte-identical to 1.0.0.73. Devicepool, TLS transport and downloader modules are code-identical after source-location normalization.

Signing/header assembly is unchanged: _sign_post_once POSTs url+headers to /sign, sign returns signer headers, _api_once merges them before HTTP. No new local Helios/Medusa generator or signature override in these call sites.

config.json changes only base_query.device_id, iid, cdid. Pool load and generation unchanged; with packaged pool present build_url overlays current device.query on config.base_query, so config ID changes do not replace the shipped pool identities. No newly added platform registration logic in the scoped code.

_api_once now checks _vm_dead after existing SG.check_response. Invalid model envelope raises _VmDead(ValueError), entering api ValueError handling instead of marking source healthy. No signatures are recalculated differently.

api skips sleep after the last allowed try in auth/risk/request-or-ValueError branches. Existing device rotation, refresh_session, and B-host fallback remain. B host still selected only for connection failure, not arbitrary empty model JSON.

_source_good accepts success at any model route as recovery for a failure at another model route. _source_probe invokes _vm_alive for all model routes. Existing strike thresholds and general source-down behavior unchanged.
